title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: tiling
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Amenities tiling
swms.task: Tile the public amenities floors and walls, cutting tiles on site with a wet saw, and grouting with epoxy grout.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the tile adhesive and epoxy grout are kept at the work area: skin sensitiser, wear chemical resistant gloves and eye protection.
facts.silicaControls: Drilling and cutting are done with on-tool dust extraction or wet methods. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while drilling or cutting. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Mix and apply adhesives, grouts, screeds and sealers
